terminals.name: api
terminals.description: FastAPI backend with local-only credentials; readiness is /health/ready.
terminals.command: . .venv/bin/activate && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd apps/api && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: worker
terminals.description: Draft Desk worker; idles until a worker credential is provisioned.
terminals.command: . .venv/bin/activate && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd apps/worker && exec python -m worker.main

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: cd apps/web && exec npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort
